text.content:
Old, big, and once Arasaka's sword. One of the Old Three.

Turf: Japantown; Kabuki through the Kimen-Gumi
Known for: Bladed weapons, archery and motorcycles; protection money on every shop that hangs a lantern
Leadership: Shinobu the Third, new in 2070
Allies & rivals: Enemies: the Mox and the G4. Patron of the Red Lanterns. The Usagi are the one yakuza family it never swallowed
Hangouts: Jig-Jig Street (#10), Clouds (#12), the Kabuki Roundabout (#5), Ho-Oh (#76), every pachinko parlor in Westbrook

One of the oldest gangs in Night City, grown out of the Tygers Claw, an Arasaka-backed motorcycle club. In the 2030s and '40s the Claws were the sword of the Nakagawa Foundation and the Night City Co-Prosperity Sphere, and they never shook their Arasaka ties. After the Purge-Riot of 2047 they absorbed every yakuza clan and most of the East Asian syndicates in the city, all but the Usagi.

Tradition and the old ways are their stated creed, muddied in practice by factions and constant infighting; outsiders who step in still face a united front. Members wear tyger tattoos, neon-lit jackets and katanas. Their masked enforcers in Kabuki, the Kimen-Gumi, wear oni masks.

2070

Since 2067 the Claws have been at war with the Mox, born after Claws killed Lizzie Borden. With Arasaka back in the open and the Sphere's firms packing up, the Claws have to decide whose sword they are. A new leader, Shinobu the Third, took over in 2070; the first thing he did was close two Claw dollhouses on Jig-Jig Street, and nobody knows why. Some call him a reformer, some say Arasaka picked him, and many wonder whether he will cool the war with the Mox.

Edgerunner's Handbook p.26; Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 02, 04, 08, 09
